entries.name: imToken token-ui
entries.notes: Recommended Web foundation (pre-approved). React + Vite + pnpm. Provides dashboard, components, design tokens, themes. Provides no engine, derivation, vault, custody, signing, RPC or indexing. Review pin 2026-11-10, not re-verified. Re-verification belongs to Phase 5, not Phase 3.
